mods.name: Create: Fantasizing Again
mods.description:
A mod that adds some powerful things for Create! Includes:
 * Two stress engines that are in perpetual motion!
 * §lTree Cutter§r: An axe that can chop down an entire tree! (Formerly a Deforester, but it makes blocks fall vertically!)
 * §lBlock Placer§r: A tool that can place blocks at extremely long distances and destroy blocks instantly! (Formerly a Handheld Blockzapper, but it has almost all its powers unlocked without upgrading! Special thanks to @LopyLuna)
 * §lTransporter§r: Easily transfer items from one container to another (Formerly a Transposer)!
 * §lCrate§r: A container that can be combined along three axes and has adjustable capacity! Also features several other practical functions... (Formerly an Adjustable Crate)
 * §lChromatic Compound§r! Maybe useless, or maybe too powerful? 

§lOther changes§r:
 * Chocolate can now be drawn infinitely! 
 * Powder Snow can be stored in tanks like fluid.

releases.notes:
- Fix a bug that causes the Fluid Barrel to duplicate the fluids.
- Fix an NPE caused by Crate. (#23 by @BazZziliuS)
- Update Russian translation. (#23 by @BazZziliuS)

releases.notes:
## New contents
- **Fluid Barrel**: Like Crate but stores fluids.
- **Casing** that is used to craft the Fluid Barrel.
- **Refined Radiance Tunnel & Shadow Steel Tunnel**: used for *Exposing* and *Shadow Plating* recipes.
- **Sculk Engine**: Like the previous two Compact Engines, but crafted by Sculk or Warden.
- **Yin Yang Engine & Taiji Chipset**: A more powerful engine and its material.

## Modifications
- The Compact Engine recipes are cheaper.
- **Heart of the Sea**, **Heavy Core**, and **Echo Shard** have copy recipes.
- **Stray** will drop Zinc Ingots by chance.
- Crate now has a more readable tooltip.
- You can rename Crate by Anvil now (Except they have a custom name already).
- You can now change the Main & Secondary relationship of Double Crate by Wrench.

## AIGC Features
- The fold button in Brass Crate & Sturdy Crate's menu is available now.
- You can now open the menu of Crates on Contraption.

Block placer safe update. Special thanks to @BazZziliuS!
For detail: #10.
> Block Placer has been nerfed for server safety: range and cooldown are now configurable, and all block operations fire proper player-attributed NeoForge events so protection mods can cancel them and logging plugins can record them.
